acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce the wrapped SHA-256 prose false positive with a focused generator fixture and identify the governing definition contract.
Exclude non-definition prose while preserving genuine supported requirement forms, stable existing IDs, staged Git-index reads and deterministic output.
Retain focused regression evidence and update the relevant spec for any changed definition recognition.
body: Observed 2026-09-30 during V1-0505 integration at reviewed source 136862c40d023d6f45b439650f51704b3d37dddc and local f21f820b task transfer. corvint-tasks build202, Core rc.1 build163, Go1.27.1. Repro: stage docs/specs/operator-update-v0.md, run make spec-requirements; generated docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv line2046 contains id SHA-256 from operator-update-v0.md line99 (a continuation of acceptance-evidence prose), while actual new requirement IDs are UPD-V0-001..006. script/gen-spec-requirements.sh scans definition-like line prefixes with a generic identifier regex; a wrapped prose prefix can become a spurious requirement. Expected only genuine requirement definitions; actual prose hash algorithm indexed as an ID. Independent reviewer retained this LOW false positive, not an updater runtime defect. Search agent-memory for SHA-256, false positive and generator found no owning duplicate. Evidence: /private/tmp/corvint-updater-evidence/generator-gap-search*.json, current source line99, generated row2046. Keep ID compatibility and decide an evidenced definition-boundary guard rather than excluding arbitrary strings without contract.
